entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable, and I want my money back now. Your website is a joke.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is that I hate it! The color is nothing like it looked online. It's hideous. I haven't even taken it out, the box is still unopened. This isn't a hard concept. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager; I can definitely handle this for you. Could I get your name and order number to pull up the details?
It's Alex Rodriguez, order number 788-B-451. You have five minutes to send me a return label or I swear I'm plastering this experience all over every cycling forum on the internet.

Thank you, Alex. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 15 days ago. I completely understand being disappointed when the color isn't what you expected. Rider safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
Yeah, yeah, whatever. So? Are you taking it back or not?

Yes, absolutely. I've just checked our policy, and since the item was delivered within the last 90 days, you are fully eligible for a refund, especially since the box is unopened. I can start that return for you right now.
Oh. Seriously? That's it? I was expecting a huge fight.

No fight necessary. I've just processed the return authorization. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. You should see it in your inbox within the next couple of minutes. Just attach that to the box and drop it off.
Wow, okay. Well, thank you, Charlie. I appreciate you just... getting it done.
You're very welcome, Alex. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all I needed. Thanks again.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
